`abstract class BaseTween<T extends BaseTween<T>>`<br/>
**Known subtypes:** [`Timeline`](/reference/animation/timeline/), [`Tween`](/reference/animation/tween/)<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.animation.tween` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [BaseTween.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/animation/tween/BaseTween.java)

Shared state and timing of a tween and a timeline: delay, repetitions, pause, events and the advance in time.

## Description

A [`Tween`](/reference/animation/tween/) or a [`Timeline`](/reference/animation/timeline/) does nothing by itself: something advances it with `update(delta)`, in milliseconds.
A [`TweenAnimator`](/reference/animation/tweenanimator/) advances its timeline once per frame; a [`TweenManager`](/reference/animation/tweenmanager/) advances what it holds when you update it; code of your own can call `update(...)` itself.
A negative delta plays backward.

- [Animation](/use/learn/style-and-motion/animation/)

<a id="BaseTween-method-start"></a>

### start

`T start()` 

**Throws:**

- `IllegalStateException`: A tween or timeline that repeats forever needs a duration or a repeat delay above 0, give it one or a finite repeat count

Builds the tween and places it at its beginning, then returns it; the next updates play it.
Throws an `IllegalStateException` for a repetition forever whose duration and repeat delay are both `0`.

`T start(TweenManager manager)` 

Adds the tween to `manager`, which starts it, then returns it.

<a id="BaseTween-method-build"></a>

### build

`T build()` 

Fixes the children and the duration of a timeline, then returns it; `start()` calls it.

<a id="BaseTween-method-kill"></a>

### kill

`T kill()` 

Stops the tween and its children for good, then returns it; `isFinished()` becomes `true`.
Killed from one of its own listeners, it stops within the same update.

<a id="BaseTween-method-pause"></a>

### pause

`T pause()` 

Freezes the tween, then returns it.

### resume

### repeat

`T repeat(int count, float delay)` 

Plays the tween `count` more times after the first, with `delay` ms between two plays, then returns it; a negative delay counts as `0`.
Throws an `IllegalStateException` once the tween is started.

<a id="BaseTween-method-update"></a>

### update

`void update(float delta)` 

Advances the tween by `delta` ms, backward when `delta` is negative, firing the events it crosses.
It does nothing before `start()`, while paused or once killed.
